title: Rank Math SEO Setup
description: Configure Rank Math for launch — modules, titles, schema, sitemaps, and Search Console integration.

steps.title: Run Rank Math Setup Wizard
steps.instructions: Complete the setup wizard: site type, logo, social profiles, and sitemap defaults. Connect your Google account if using analytics modules.

steps.title: Enable Required Modules
steps.instructions: Turn on Sitemap, Schema, Redirections, and 404 Monitor as needed. Disable unused modules to reduce overhead.

steps.title: Configure Titles & Meta
steps.instructions: Set global title and description templates per post type. Define homepage, blog, and archive meta patterns.

steps.title: Add LocalBusiness or Organization Schema
steps.instructions: Configure default schema type with name, URL, logo, and contact info. Validate a sample page with Rich Results Test.

steps.title: Review XML Sitemap Settings
steps.instructions: Confirm sitemap URLs are reachable. Exclude cart, checkout, my-account, and other non-indexable routes.

steps.title: Import or Add Redirect Rules
steps.instructions: Import redirects from a migration or add rules for changed URLs. Test top landing pages return 200 or 301 as expected.

steps.title: Verify Search Console & Sitemap
steps.instructions: Submit the Rank Math sitemap in Search Console. Fix coverage issues for important templates and key landing pages.
